text:
marco: dropping the RFI + capability CSV for Lifecycle Health. Need SE/ProdSec/Legal review before we hand to procurement tomorrow. Attached: lifecycle_rfi_draft.pdf, lifecycle_capmatrix.csv

tayla: reading now. buyer asked for a short POC with embedding throughput ~400 concurrent calls and an on-prem option. Do we propose Hosted credits or a Dedicated eval?

marco: recommend Hosted trial with a reserved burst week; faster onboarding. Dedicated only if they need tenant isolation. I added both numbers in the capmatrix.

devon: POC plan: 2d install/verify, 5d steady, 2d spike. I'll add benchmark_plan.md and a tiny harness. Perf snippet:
```
./run_poc --model redwood-1b-quant --concurrency 400 --batch 16
```

indra: Security checklist: missing KMS/HSM details, data residency line, and log retention for the POC. Also need confirmation on whether any data is staged in our account during ingest. Fill Q20-Q27 in security_questionnaire.xlsx.

marco: note: propose customer-managed collector writing to their S3; we don't stage PII. Will make explicit.

legal: I'll review T&Cs. Two asks: tighten POC liability language and attach the standard DPA. I'll upload redlines by 09:30 PT.

files-bot: Uploaded lifecycle_rfi_draft.pdf (2.0MB), lifecycle_capmatrix.csv (38KB), benchmark_plan.md (3KB)

tayla: pricing: embeddings priced per 1k units. With peak pattern estimate the sheet may need a 20% safety buffer. I'll add a `poc_costs.csv` conservative vs optimistic.

devon: adding a curl smoke-test for infra teams:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-medium","input":"clinical summary test"}'
```

indra: if they require HSM-backed keys on-prem, Private deployment supports customer HSM but adds ~3 weeks. Call that out in POC constraints.

marco: timeline: incorporate edits, hand to Legal & ProdSec, send to buyer by 11:00 PT. Ping when you finish signoffs.

tayla: SE signoff done (benchmark plan + harness). I uploaded synthetic dataset link in the plan.

indra: ProdSec signoff pending small KMS phrasing; I'll update Q24 and confirm.

legal: redlines uploaded: lifecycle_rfi_legal_redlines.docx. Added DPA link and tightened liability.

marco: thanks all  sending to buyer now. cc @lifecycle-ops (external) :rocket:
